# Assertion replay findings — September 7, 2026

Source implementation: infrastructure commits `44378b9` and `6cb36df`. See [live replay report](REPLAY.html), [per-API summary](summary.json), and [isolated contract diagnostics](contract_followup.json).

## Completed A2 replay

149 API outcomes: 127 native passes, 120 isolated assertions-off passes, 114 isolated assertions-on passes. All 149 were replayed. 127 snippets were recovered from full native passing code; 22 full retained failing snippets matched their native failure-code prefix. These are differing strengths of historical evidence.

The assertions-on results contain 114 passes, 14 compilation failures, 15 runtime failures and 6 assertion failures. A native failure may change category when an earlier assertion now stops execution.

## Assertions-off passes that fail with assertions on

| API | Observed on-replay failure | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `IfdStructure` | __RUN_ERR__ AssertionError: The documented contract is insufficient to verify the result | [JSON](cases/8bf492a758d7d4540e7601dcc9d1b2c97b6e0a27a1c903b2e622c9b96cb42e86.json) |
| `getBoolean` | __RUN_ERR__ AssertionError: The documented contract is insufficient to verify the result of getBoolean | [JSON](cases/3a3436579d825529d6b1183caf913265aff357acfffbd96a27a083ea1bca71e7.json) |
| `getKey` | __RUN_ERR__ AssertionError: Rendering key mismatch | [JSON](cases/fc3c332d74435ec178fadba8afa1d646f4f399f6c94f7df332fc525f2dd8eb63.json) |
| `getResizer` | __RUN_ERR__ AssertionError: Factory should select different resizer implementations for upscaling vs downscaling | [JSON](cases/54e87b20a266e39ca8fe993b17f2f6253445835dcf7f5d9e90e55c931ad52d27.json) |
| `preferredOutputFormatName` | __RUN_ERR__ NullPointerException: null | [JSON](cases/b3652b4db8816d40018274ee95d55b8da5b447d27c740fd0ec4675494cd39c5b.json) |
| `value` | __RUN_ERR__ AssertionError: The documented contract is insufficient to verify the exact integer result of value() | [JSON](cases/66448ff2091b9f2fc6107c5c9643a28be1ea5857d8fb83f49ee7764c171c729e.json) |

`IfdStructure`, `getBoolean`, and `value` contain unconditional false assertions. `preferredOutputFormatName` evaluates `.equals` on null `ORIGINAL_FORMAT` inside an assertion; enabling assertions exposes that expression. `getResizer` compares implementation classes, but the factory returns different enum values (`PROGRESSIVE` and `BICUBIC`) of the same class. This is a bad test oracle, not proof of a factory defect.

**Library defect candidate:** `Rendering.DEFAULT.getKey()` returns `KEY_ALPHA_INTERPOLATION`, while its value is a rendering hint. The pinned source and isolated runtime agree; the returned key rejects its own value. This supports a source-level issue for developer review. No upstream source was changed or external issue posted.

## Native passes that fail in both fresh replay variants

`FileImageSink`, `FileThumbnailTask`, `allowOverwrite`, `createThumbnailsAsCollection`, `determineOutputFormat`, `toFile`, `toFiles`

All seven encounter missing paths beneath `outputPath`, whose configured value ends in `thumbnail.png`. Their code treats that file path as a directory. Fresh per-test outputs expose a dependence on shared filesystem state; no output data was fabricated to make them pass. This diagnosis does not establish exactly which historical test created the required directory.

## Evidence path collision

The case-insensitive filesystem aliases `run_Region` with `run_region`, and `run_Watermark` with `run_watermark`. Full native A2 passing code recovers both overwritten uppercase snippets. New replay directories use content hashes. A1 legacy rows without sufficient native code are marked unbound; ambiguous case-colliding rows are skipped. The current measured harness is preserved.

## Accepted boundary

The user authorized isolated replay and side-by-side reporting. There are zero Gemini calls and zero snippet or documentation fixes. Native results and documentation-repair decisions remain unchanged. This replay does not certify API correctness across the public surface or the entire documentation-repair pipeline. A separately reviewed matched revision is required for that stronger claim.
